title: Flux through a cube around a point charge
change: New geometry (cube) and a numeric flux from Q_enc/ε₀; seed was a symbolic statement of Gauss's law; distractors are inverted ratio, kQ, and per-face flux.

title: Net flux with charges inside and outside
change: Several enclosed charges of mixed sign plus an outside charge; numbers all new; distractors include outside charge, magnitude sum and omitted charge.

title: Moving charges around a Gaussian surface
change: Conceptual: flux depends only on enclosed charge, tested by moving inside and outside charges; distractors are field-strength confusion, symmetry requirement and distance dependence.

title: Charge in a uniformly charged sphere
change: Evaluates the volume integral for the simplest case (uniform density) with new numbers; seed asked for the integral setup symbolically.

title: Charge enclosed with a density that grows with radius
change: Density depends on r (ρ = αr) so the full spherical-shell integral is required; numbers new.

title: Charge enclosed within a hollow charged region
change: Piecewise density with an empty core: requires choosing correct limits for the volume integral.

title: Field from a linear potential
change: Linear potential with a constant offset, new numbers; one sign-only distractor allowed and used.

title: Field from a quadratic potential
change: Nonlinear V(x) evaluated at a point; distractors are E=-V, -V/x and a differentiation slip (no sign-only distractor).

title: Field in each region of a potential profile
change: Piecewise-linear V(x) given by values: reads slopes in two segments, both signs required.

title: Field where the potential is constant
change: Constant potential region (equipotential), new context; same E = −dV/dx = 0 idea.

title: Locating zero field from a potential function
change: Solve dV/dx = 0 for a quadratic V; distractors from V=0 roots and derivative slip.

title: Field between a maximum and a minimum of V
change: Graph-reading conceptual item with a maximum and a minimum of V; one sign/direction-only distractor allowed and used.

title: Pulling capacitor plates apart
change: Qualitative scaling of C = ε₀A/d with separation (vacuum); different from seed's formula-recall question.

title: Capacitance of rectangular plates
change: Numeric calculation with a unit conversion; distractors: unit slip, inverted ratio, length for area.

title: Comparing two parallel-plate capacitors
change: Two-factor scaling of C = ε₀A/d with circular plates (area ∝ r²).

title: Energy in a charged capacitor
change: Numeric U = ½C(ΔV)² with new values; the seed asked for the formula.

title: Stored energy when plates are separated
change: Conceptual ratio reasoning with U = ½QΔV at fixed Q; distractors are fixed-V and partial-substitution errors.

title: Energy to charge a capacitor further
change: Energy difference between two states of a capacitor (U quadratic in V); numeric.

title: Field inside a charged metal sphere
change: New context (solid copper sphere, point inside the metal); same E = 0 in a conductor at equilibrium; distractors are continuity-across-surface, insulator pattern and self-repulsion.

title: Neutral metal slab in an external field
change: Quantitative external-field version with a neutral slab and induced charges; same E = 0 inside a conductor in equilibrium.

title: Potential at the center of a charged conductor
change: Moves from the field to its consequence, an equipotential conductor, with new numbers (R = 0.30 m, Q = 6.0 nC); looser than the seed's direct E = 0 recall but still the conductor-equilibrium idea.

title: Halving the separation
change: Halving instead of tripling; the same inverse-square scaling idea with a different factor.

title: Force between two small charged spheres
change: Quantitative Coulomb's-law calculation with new charges and distance (not a ratio); same force-versus-separation relation.

title: Combined change of charge and separation
change: Two simultaneous changes (one charge and the separation) with a starting force given in newtons; same Coulomb scaling, a step beyond the one-variable seed.

title: Field east of a positive charge
change: Positive source and east direction instead of a negative source; the only variant of this seed using a direction-only distinction.

title: Field magnitude near a negative charge
change: Asks for magnitude and direction with numbers (−4.0 nC, 0.20 m); distractors differ in magnitude, not sign.

title: Field between opposite charges
change: Superposition of two opposite charges at a midpoint, with magnitude and direction; applies the direction rule for each source and adds.

title: Charge on a uniformly charged rod
change: Uniform rod with total charge from dq = λ dx, a simpler quantitative use of the same line-charge element.

title: Charge on a rod with a linear density ramp
change: Nonuniform linear density with an integral for the total charge; the same idea dq = λ ds with the density varying in position.

title: Charge on a nonuniform arc
change: Circular arc with ds = R dθ and an angle-dependent density; same charge-element-from-density skill used on an arc, one of the CED's listed geometries.

title: Flux through a tilted plane
change: Numeric flux at 60° with new values; same Φ = EA cos θ.

title: Flux through a loop parallel to the field
change: Loop whose plane is parallel to the field (θ = 90° to the normal); same flux relation Φ = EA cos θ in a limiting orientation.

title: Flux from field components
change: Components version: flux as E·A with a tilted field and an axis-aligned surface; same Φ = EA cos θ with the angle given implicitly.

title: Net flux with charges inside and outside
change: Quantitative Gauss's-law flux with an enclosed and an outside charge; same idea that outside charges give zero net flux.

title: Point charge near a cube
change: Charge outside a cube instead of a general statement about contributions; same zero net flux from outside charge, with the face-by-face flux explained.

title: Adding a charge outside a closed surface
change: Adds a charge outside to a surface that encloses a charge; asks which quantities change (local field changes, net flux does not).

title: Pulling opposite charges apart
change: Opposite charges pulled apart instead of like charges pushed together; same U = kq₁q₂/r direction-of-change idea. Direction-only variant for this seed.

title: Energy change for an attracting pair
change: Quantitative change in U for an opposite-charge pair with new charges and distances.

title: Total energy of three fixed charges
change: Three-charge system energy by summing distinct pair terms; new charges and geometry.

title: Potential near a small charged sphere
change: Numerical point-charge potential; new charge and distance; distractors are field formula, missing r and spurious ½.

title: Scaling potential with distance
change: Ratio reasoning from V = kq/r with a negative charge; no formula recall needed.

title: Potential difference from integrating the field
change: Derive potential difference by integrating the point-charge field between two radii.

title: Negative grain released in a field
change: Negative charge released from rest; key requires combining sign of q, U = qV and energy conservation. Direction-only variant for this seed.

title: Energy change between two potentials
change: Quantitative ΔU = qΔV for a positive charge moved between two potentials; new values.

title: Speed gained by a negative particle
change: Energy conservation combining ΔU = qΔV for a negative charge with kinetic energy.

title: Why the surface field is perpendicular
change: Asks for the reason for the perpendicular surface field rather than its direction; same conductor-in-equilibrium concept.

title: Neutral sphere in a uniform field
change: New configuration (neutral conductor in an external field) requiring perpendicular direction plus induced-charge sign. Contains the one direction-based distractor for this seed.

title: Field at a tip and a flat face
change: Combines perpendicular direction with the charge-density-at-points property of conductors.

title: Dielectric in an isolated capacitor
change: Disconnected (fixed-charge) counterpart of the seed's battery-connected case; same stored-energy-with-dielectric concept.

title: Energy with a dielectric on a battery
change: Quantitative battery-connected case with new C, V and κ.

title: Energy change after removing the battery
change: Change in energy for a dielectric inserted at fixed charge, with a fixed-voltage trap.

title: Field of a long charged wire
change: New numbers and numeric evaluation of the infinite-line Gauss's-law result.

title: Inside a uniformly charged cylinder
change: Gauss's law inside a uniformly charged long cylinder; same cylindrical-symmetry skill with volume density.

title: Wire inside a charged shell
change: Gauss's law for a line charge plus coaxial shell, outside both; new geometry. Direction-only distractor for this seed.

title: Charge enclosed by a coaxial Gaussian cylinder
change: New geometry (cylindrical symmetry, line charge) and numbers; same task of finding q_enc for a Gaussian surface. Distractors: lateral-area, density-as-charge, charge-on-surface confusions.

title: Charge inside a uniformly charged ball
change: Gaussian surface inside a uniform solid sphere (seed had r > R for a thin shell); q_enc from volume ratio with new numbers.

title: Enclosed charge between a sphere and a shell
change: Two-object configuration with a shell outside the Gaussian surface; q_enc needs the sphere's radius R, not r. Distractors from the documented r-versus-R and outside-charge errors.

title: Field from a potential function
change: Given V(x) as a function rather than a qualitative sign statement; numerical E_x = −dV/dx. Distractors avoid sign-only contrasts.

title: Field from a piecewise potential
change: Piecewise-linear potential with new numbers; asks for the field in the sloped region. No sign-only distractor.

title: Potential difference from a field
change: Inverse direction (V from E by integration, with a non-uniform field). One sign-only distractor (drop of the minus sign), the only one in this seed's variants.

title: Midpoint of two equal positive charges
change: Like charges (field zero, potential nonzero) rather than the seed's opposite charges; numeric values for E and V.

title: Midpoint of unequal opposite charges
change: Unequal opposite charges, both quantities nonzero, computed numerically; distractors mix up vector and scalar superposition.

title: Zero-field point and its potential
change: Field-zero location between unequal positive charges plus the potential at that point; distractors: E = 0 implies V = 0, one-charge potential, 1/r field law.

title: Field inside a uniformly charged ball versus surface
change: Ratio form of the interior field of a uniform sphere (proportionality to r) with new fraction; qualitative-quantitative rather than a closed formula with ρ.

title: Field inside a long charged cylinder
change: Cylindrical symmetry (inside) in place of spherical, numeric; distractors use the spherical result, a dropped factor, and the exterior formula.

title: Field in a sphere with non-uniform charge density
change: Non-uniform density requiring ∫ρ dV for q_enc, then Gauss's law inside a sphere (harder than the seed's uniform case, same concept).

title: Where excess charge sits on a conductor
change: Same conductor-equilibrium concept (E = 0 inside) probed through where excess charge resides; no sign pair.

title: Induced charges on a shell with a cavity
change: Cavity with enclosed charge: induced inner/outer surface charges from E = 0 in the conductor and Gauss's law (new context, same concept).

title: Fields around a charged shell holding a charge
change: Concentric conductor with enclosed charge and net shell charge: zero field in the metal, exterior field from net charge; distractors from shielding misconceptions.

title: Flux through two opposite faces of a cube
change: Two faces rather than one, with a numeric charge; requires the same symmetry share of q/ε₀.

title: Charge from flux through one cube face
change: Inverse problem (charge from face flux) in place of flux from charge; same symmetry share.

title: Flux through a dome with the charge on its base
change: Half-space symmetry: charge at the center of the base of a dome; flux through the dome is q/(2ε₀). Same symmetry-share-of-q/ε₀ idea in a new geometry.
